run_type: baseline (first run - no prior state to diff against)
requirement: breakfast included, cheapest room that fits 3
scope: Fri->Sun weekends, Sep-Nov 2026 (rows 1-13 of tracking table)

methodology.source: triverna.pl hotel pages, date-picker calendar DOM + 'Do zaplaty brutto' total
methodology.note: Calendar cell = lowest nightly rate for the CHEAPEST room, not necessarily the room that fits 3. Weekend total = Fri night + Sat night, plus extra-bed surcharge where applicable.
methodology.caution: The 'Do zaplaty brutto' figure animates upward on load. Must wait ~6-8s before reading or the value is wrong (observed 20 -> 49 -> 1191 -> 1830 on one page).
